verdict.rationale: The docs contain static code snippets (e.g., a Swift streaming example) and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint page, but nothing shows an interactive API explorer or runnable-in-browser examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable spec backs an interactive reference. Static snippets are adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
